title: Assessment: Single and Double Replacement Reactions
description: Checkpoint assessment on classifying replacement reactions and explaining partner switches.

questions.question: Which reaction best matches A + BC -> AC + B?
questions.explanation: Zn is a free element replacing Cu in CuCl2, so it follows A + BC -> AC + B.

questions.question: Which reaction best matches AB + CD -> AD + CB?
questions.explanation: HCl and NaOH are two compounds that exchange partners to form NaCl and H2O, so this is double replacement.

questions.question: In Fe + CuSO4 -> FeSO4 + Cu, which element is replaced?
questions.explanation: Fe replaces Cu in copper(II) sulfate. Cu is released as a product.

questions.question: In AgNO3 + NaCl -> AgCl + NaNO3, which pair forms after the partner switch?
questions.explanation: Silver ions pair with chloride ions after the switch, forming AgCl.

questions.question: A cloudy solid appears when two clear solutions are mixed. Which clue for double replacement is this?
questions.explanation: A cloudy solid is evidence that an insoluble precipitate formed, a common clue for double replacement.

questions.question: True or False: In double replacement, both reactants are usually compounds.
questions.explanation: True. Double replacement involves two compounds exchanging positive and negative partners.

questions.question: True or False: In Cu + 2AgNO3 -> Cu(NO3)2 + 2Ag, copper replaces silver.
questions.explanation: True. Copper starts as a free element and replaces silver in silver nitrate.

questions.question: True or False: The polyatomic ion NO3 should often be tracked as a group in replacement reaction patterns.
questions.explanation: True. Groups such as NO3 and SO4 often move together when identifying partner switches.

questions.question: Fill in the word: AB + CD -> AD + CB is the pattern for _____ replacement.
questions.explanation: The pattern shows two compounds exchanging partners, so it is double replacement.

questions.question: Fill in the missing product pattern: A + BC -> AC + _____.
questions.explanation: In single replacement, A joins C and B is released, giving AC + B.

questions.question: A classmate says Zn + CuSO4 -> ZnSO4 + Cu is double replacement because there are two products. Correct the error in one or two sentences.
questions.correctAnswer: It is single replacement because Zn is a free element that replaces Cu in CuSO4. The number of products alone does not determine the reaction type.
questions.explanation: The classification depends on the partner change. Element plus compound forming compound plus element is single replacement.

questions.question: For Pb(NO3)2 + 2KI -> PbI2 + 2KNO3, identify the reaction type and describe the partner switch.
questions.correctAnswer: It is a double replacement reaction. Pb pairs with I to form PbI2, and K pairs with NO3 to form KNO3.
questions.explanation: Both reactants are compounds, and the ions exchange partners. The nitrate group stays together as NO3.
